Context: Hostel Aocommodatien

Licence fee in case of allotment of higher accommodation.Where, due to adequate availability of quarters of a particular type, a Government servant is allotted accommodation of a type higher than his entitlement, only flat rate of licence fee relevant to that type of accommodation is to be charged from such allottee.
